title: Spark Market Participant Client
goal: Add a local participant workflow for discovering, claiming, and completing signed Spark Market tasks.
features: Complete a claimed task with proof
View activity associated with the participant DID
Keep private identity material outside the repository

live_test.completion_proof: Contribution #9 participant workflow tested successfully with the local signed participation client
